mapper.select: SELECT r.RESOURCE_ID, r.RESOURCE_NAME, r.VERSION_ID, r.ENV_CD, r.CENTER_CD, r.HOST_NAME, r.IP_ADDR, r.NSIGHT_AREA_CD, r.ORG_CD, r.OWNER_USER_ID, r.EOS_STATUS_CD, r.RISK_GRADE_CD, r.EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN, r.USE_YN, r.DISPOSE_YN, r.REMARK, p.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.RESOURCE_TYPE_CD, v.VERSION_NO, l.EOS_YMD, l.EOL_YMD, l.GA_YMD, l.LFC_ID FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE r JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_VER v ON v.VERSION_ID = r.VERSION_ID JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = v.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC l ON l.VERSION_ID = v.VERSION_ID AND l.EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL WHERE r.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId}
SELECT EOS_YMD, EOL_YMD FROM TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC WHERE VERSION_ID = #{versionId} AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('DONE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RISK_ASSESS WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_EXC_REQ WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_PRODUCT_VER WHERE VERSION_ID = #{versionId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EOS_RESOURCE SET RESOURCE_NAME = #{resourceName}, VERSION_ID = #{versionId}, ENV_CD = #{envCd}, CENTER_CD = #{centerCd}, HOST_NAME = #{hostName}, IP_ADDR = #{ipAddr}, NSIGHT_AREA_CD = #{nsightAreaCd}, ORG_CD = #{orgCd}, OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId}, EOS_STATUS_CD = #{eosStatusCd}, REMARK = #{remark}, CHG_USER_ID = #{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM = #{chgDtm} WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND DISPOSE_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_EOS_RESOURCE SET DISPOSE_YN = 'Y', USE_YN = 'N', REMARK = #{remark}, CHG_USER_ID = #{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM = #{chgDtm} WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND DISPOSE_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT POLICY_VAL FROM TB_EOS_POLICY WHERE POLICY_TYPE_CD = #{policyTypeCd} AND POLICY_KEY = #{policyKey} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
